summary: A fork of the SLOOP groovebox that swaps its engines for a single six-operator DX7 engine, ported from Dexed, with three synth parts and an FM drum track you can program on the device.
features: DX7 engine: 32 algorithms, full voice editing on the unit, low-pass filter
Load your own DX7 banks as .syx: 8 banks of 32 voices
16-sound FM drum kits with per-sound macros, step locks and a random kit
Patterns up to 128 steps; SLOOP layers, song mode and punch-in effects
USB and TRS MIDI with clock and per-track channels; USB audio
Beta: the dual-core 4.0 build has not been tested on a device yet

headings: the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
